bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam 'od dpag med kyi thugs rje'i sa bon byang chub myu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/na mo/phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs

tei:div.tei:p: )bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam 'od dpag med kyi thugs rje'i sa bon byang chub myu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha yi tshogs// mkha' 'gro dam can dpang gyur ma lus pa// bdag la gsan cing thugs rjes gzigs su gsol// bdag dang bdag la 'brel gyur sems can kun// zhing khams 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /las dang nyon mongs bag chags lhag ro rnams// 'chi 'phos bar dor ma lus byang gyur cig /skad cig de la bar do mngon gyur nas// yi dam mkha' 'gro dag pa'i snang ba mthong*// chos kyi sa la gtan srid zin gyur nas// mngon par mtha' yas sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /mkha' la brten pa'i nub phyogs bde ba can// shin tu rgya che pad+ma'i 'dab ltar dang*// 'od zer dpag med mtha' yas zhi zhing dul// rnam dag bde ba can du skye bar shog /khrus kyi rdzing bu kha khyer mu ran du// sna tshogs pad+ma'i tshal gyi rwa bas bskor// snyan pa'i sgra dang dri bsung ngad pa 'khrigs// mdzes pa'i pad+mo che las 'khrungs par shog /'khrungs ma khad du lha mo'i khrus gsol zhing*// phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus pas// g.yel ba med par thugs rjes brtser gzigs nas// dam pa'i lam ston rjes su 'dzin par shog /sa mchog thob pa'i gom pa bdun bor nas// pañca li ka'i gos kyi rab g.yogs shing*// 'dod yon du ma'i mchod sprin longs spyod nas// kun bzang chos kyi thugs la spyod par shog /'od dpag med kyi zhabs drung der 'khod nas// thugs rje'i zhabs la mgo bos reg pa dang*// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mngon par lhang nger mjal// chos kyi bdud rtsi rtag tu 'thung bar shog /smin grol bla med dngos grub thob pa dang*// sa mchog 'od gsal rdo rje'i rtse mo ru// thar lam mchog gi brten pa thob byas nas// mngon par mtha' yas myur du sangs rgyas shog

/blo yis stobs kyis sprul pa bsam yas shing*// phyogs bcu'i zhing dang 'gro drug ma lus par// gang la gang 'dul de la der sprul zhing*// ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stongs par shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas ring por ma lon par// chos gsung mi bzhed mya ngan 'da' bzhed gang*// mya ngan mi 'da' yun du bzhugs pa dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo dag kyang bskor bar bskul// 'od dpag med pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa ru// mngon par dbang bskur rigs kyi che ba thob// pad+ma lta bu'i sku mtshan dpe byad 'bar// 'od zer gzi brjid mtha' yas thob par shog /dpag med zhing la dbang bsgyur sa bcu thob// dpag bsam shing chen dgos 'dod lhun gyis grub// tā la'i phreng bas sil snyan mang bskyod cing*// mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang byed shog /spos kyi mtsho la tshul khrims rlung gis bskyod// sman gyi ro la dri ngad phun sum tshogs// sna yi rnam shes gnas dag sems dpa' thob// dri yi 'dod yon phun sum tshogs thob shog /gser gyi sa gzhi mig mang ris su chags// gnam sa bar snang dgos 'dod char du 'bebs// mdzes pa'i lha dang lha mo sna tshogs bskyod// mig gi rnam shes gnas dag mchog thob shog /sgra snyan rol mo mang dkrol yid dbang bsgyur// bya rigs skad snyan lha mo'i glu yis bstod// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis dus kun sgra sgrogs shing*// rna ba'i rnam shes gnas dag sa thob shog /reg 'jam srab mnyen bde drod bsil yangs shing*// kha dog lnga ldan sna tshogs gos mchog dang*// reg bde lha mo reg bya tshad med pa// kun la bde ba mchog gi sa thob shog /bdud rtsi ro mchog brgyad ldan zhal zas dang*// 'dod yon sna tshogs yid la gang bsam pa// mkha' las babs dang gzhi las skyes pa'i rigs// ro mchog longs spyod mi zad mchog thob shog /rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad// lha mo bcu drug ma rmos lo 'bras dang*// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing mchog che// bdud rtsi'i chu sogs chos rigs mchog thob shog

/zhing la dbang byed 'khor lo dag la bsgyur// sde dang dpung sogs 'dod yon lhun gyis grub// bya spyod ma lus dam pa'i chos mchog ste// lhun grub sa la gtan srid zin par shog /ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mchog thob cing*// rdzu 'phrul mngon shes yon tan dpag mi lang*// lam lnga mthar phyin mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang myur thob shog /rdzu 'phrul zhabs ldan skye 'chi gnyis med pa'i// rdo rje lta bu'i tshe yi dngos grub brnyes// sprul dang yang sprul du mas sems can rnams// gang 'dul der ston sangs rgyas sa thob shog /ye shes spyan ldan smon lam stobs lnga ldan// thugs rje'i stobs bcu 'phags pa'i lam rdzogs shing*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// sku gsung thugs mchog dbyer med sangs rgyas shog /bdag gis lhag bsam smon lam btab pa bzhin// rgyal dang rgyal sras nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa dgra bcom sogs// bden pa 'grub pa'i rig 'dzin smon lam shog /ces bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam rnam par dag pa 'di ni/ bdag dpa' bo stag sham nus ldan rdo rje ngas dpal rta mgrin gyi gter sgrub la zhugs tshe/ bde ba can du skye ba'i dbugs dbyung zhing zhing khams mthong snang yang rab rib tsam la brten nas/ bdag gi ma rgan 'byung bzhi'i g.yar po brjes nas sems nyid bag la zha ba'i dge rtsar dmigs nas de ma thag tu bris pa'o// dge bas ma lus bde ba can du skye bar gyur cig// /
